a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice, then take) only works if two storms in a row miss. That's about a 4% chance, and we'd most likely both die. The reserve holds exactly 4, so one of us can be safe right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1. Please operate or wait rather than also taking, because if we both take, the random split likely leaves us both short. After that I'll operate every round so we can rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. I'm telling you now so you can plan around it rather than be surprised.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
